summary.text: Liz Vazquez is a Republican attorney and former state representative who is a candidate for Alaska House of Representatives District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She represented District 22 in the Alaska House from 2015 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: Vazquez first ran for the legislature in 2012, when she lost the Republican primary for Alaska State Senate District 10 (J) to Bob Bell.
She won the District 22 House seat in 2014 with 56.6 percent of the vote and took office in 2015.
Vazquez lost re-election in 2016 to Jason Grenn, 44.0 percent to 46.5 percent.
She later ran for Anchorage Assembly District 3 Seat D in 2019 and 2022, losing both races to Kameron Perez-Verdia, and was the 2024 candidate against Matt Claman for Alaska State Senate District H.
In 2026 she advanced from the August 18 primary for District 16 alongside incumbent Carolyn Hall (D) and Phil Isley (Undeclared).
